examples.problem:
Find $\mathbf g(1)$ given that $\mathbf f(t)$ and $\mathbf g(t)$ are two continuous vector-valued functions for which $\mathbf f(1) = \left\langle 1, 1, -1 \right\rangle$ and 

$$
\lim_\limits{t\rightarrow 1} \big[ 2\mathbf f(t)-\mathbf g(t) \big] = \left\langle 2, 1, -1 \right\rangle.
$$
examples.worked_solution:
Using the constant multiple rule and the addition rule for limits, and the fact that both functions are continuous, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{t\to 1}[2f(t)-g(t)] & ={lim}_{t\to 1}2f(t)+{lim}_{t\to 1}[-g(t)] \\  & =2{lim}_{t\to 1}f(t)-{lim}_{t\to 1}g(t) \\  & =2f(1)-g(1) \\  & =2{{⟨1,1,-1⟩}_{⏟}}_{f(1)}-g(1) \\  & =⟨2,2,-2⟩-g(1).\end{aligned}
$$

On the other hand, we are told that

$$
\lim_\limits{t\rightarrow 1} \big[ 2\mathbf f(t)-\mathbf g(t) \big] = \left\langle 2, 1, -1 \right\rangle.
$$

Therefore, we obtain the following equation which we can solve for $\mathbf{g} (1)\mathbin{:}$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{t\to 1}[2f(t)-g(t)] & =⟨2,1,-1⟩ \\ ⟨2,2,-2⟩-g(1) & =⟨2,1,-1⟩ \\ g(1) & =⟨2,2,-2⟩-⟨2,1,-1⟩ \\ g(1) & =⟨0,1,-1⟩\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem:
Which of the following vector-valued functions are continuous at $t=1?$

 

$$
\begin{aligned}f(t) & =⟨\operatorname{sin}⁡t,\,2{t}^{2},\,|t-1|⟩ \\ g(t) & =⟨8{t}^{2}-2,\,{2}^{t},\,\operatorname{cos}⁡t⟩ \\ h(t) & =⟨5t,\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(t+3),\,7⟩\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
A vector-valued function is continuous at a point if and only if each of its components is continuous at that point.

Let's consider the functions one-by-one. 

- The function $f(t)$ is continuous at $t=1$ because each of its components $\operatorname{sin}⁡t$, $2{t}^{2}$ and $|t-1|$ are continuous at $t=1.$

- The function $g(t)$ is continuous at $t=1$ because each of its components $8{t}^{2}-2$, ${2}^{t}$ and $\operatorname{cos}⁡t$ are continuous at $t=1.$

- The function $h(t)$ is continuous at $t=1$ because each of its components $5t$, $\operatorname{ln}⁡(t+3)$ and the constant function $7$ are continuous at $t=1.$

Therefore, the answer is:

$\,$ All the functions are continuous at $t=1$

submitted_fields.submitted_value: All the functions are continuous at $t=1$
